records.claim: One report suggested that long-term use of antihistamines like cetirizine might lower sperm counts. Low sperm counts might lower a man’s fertility (ability to get a woman pregnant). In general, exposures that fathers or sperm donors have are unlikely to increase risks to a pregnancy. For more information, please see the MotherToBaby fact sheet Paternal Exposures at https://mothertobaby.org/fact-sheets/paternal-exposures-pregnancy/.
records.source_section: If a man takes cetirizine, could it affect his fertility or increase the chance of birth defects?
